selection_filter.description: 100 entries stratified by category from the union of original full-reference failures and unscored outputs in the 1,113-image local-speed and corrected-cloud evaluation.
selection_filter.split_method: Within-category exact-image-hash groups; select evaluation hashes by SHA-256 rank of point4-cloud-eval-v1:<image_sha256>, rounded to 20% per category with at least one evaluation hash when a category has two or more; all duplicate hashes remain in one split.

evaluation_policy.words: whitespace-delimited units containing Unicode word characters
evaluation_policy.short_words: one edit for words of two or more characters; single characters exact
evaluation_policy.normalization: NFKC, casefold and punctuation removal for tolerant coverage only
evaluation_policy.exact: literal case-sensitive words including attached symbols; standalone punctuation excluded
evaluation_policy.word_splits: adjacent OCR fragments may cover one reference word
evaluation_policy.region_order: word order is preserved within each reference region; order between regions is ignored
evaluation_policy.region_grouping: observations overlapping multiple independent reference regions are reported as conflicts and prevent passing
evaluation_policy.reference_scope: annotated reference only, not necessarily all visible image text

decision_pricing.scope: standard global rates; regional and long-context premiums excluded

cloud-default.protocol: Sequential images/configurations; local-only workers restart every four images for observed MPS memory growth; no reference access during inference; no benchmark-level retries.
